role: previously inspected Final-QA Validation reused as development only

logistic_features.target: paired history exact and image-only not exact on a disagreement
logistic_features.threshold_selection: maximize training-fold supported-label macro-F1 subject to exact and option micro-F1 not below image-only by more than 0.001

selection.tie_break: higher exact accuracy, then higher option micro-F1, then simpler policy

requirements: OOF question exact accuracy is not below image-only by more than 0.001
OOF option micro-F1 is not below image-only by more than 0.001
history is used for at least one disagreement
advancement.next_step_after_go: train the selected gate on all development cases, freeze a separate confirmation protocol, then decide whether the cost of B3/B6 Test generation is justified

boundary: This is post-hoc development informed by known Validation outcomes. OOF predictions prevent case reuse within each fold but do not make Validation an untouched confirmation set. No clinical-accuracy, external-validation, or Test claim is permitted.
